name: comp-465
title: Pagination With Counter
description: A slim pager with Previous and Next around pages 1 to 4 and an ellipsis, paired with a Go to page field for typing a number directly.
use: Long result sets where a numbered pager and a direct page box share one row.
avoid: When the box must navigate: there is no button or Enter handler, so typing alone does nothing.
a11y: The input is tied to its label and each arrow is named; the page field does not act on Enter, so its value is not submitted. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: On black, a tiny arrow-led pager shows pages 1 to 4 with 3 in a rounded box and an ellipsis before the forward arrow. Across a wide gap at the right, a Go to page label sits beside a narrow outlined text box.
behaves: The page links follow hash links while the text box accepts typed digits, here changing from 3 to 7. Nothing animates and the active page stays on 3.
customise: currentPage and totalPages set the page links and the input's starting value; the input width and the row gap are classes.
weight: light: A short pager and one text input; nothing loops or animates.
